name: René Moffatt
_note: ADDED 2026-09-20 with the signet-new-act skill, from renemoffatt.com (a Bandzoogle site: home, about, music, videos, tiny desk, EPK, contact) and his channel, youtube.com/@renemoffatt, on Daniel's direction ('we've added a new artist, an original singer songwriter'). Named because he arrives with his own site, his own channel, a catalogue of six records and a band that plays under his name, which is the definition of fronted in _players_note. Facts on the page trace to his EPK (venues, festivals, the Wildflower and Ullrgrass finalist placings, the Alex Dezen quotes, Wheat Ridge as home), his about page (the influences and the playlist company), his tiny desk page (an NPR Tiny Desk Contest entry every year 2019 to 2026), his music page (the six releases and a holiday playlist) and his channel description (a Denver Public Library Volume Denver featured artist). His band is René Moffatt & The Moonshadows; an earlier band name on one 2024 upload, The Broken Fever, is not published here. The booking contact on his site is booking@renemoffatt.com; the phone on his EPK is not published. The accent in René is his spelling and stays; the id and every path are plain ASCII.
_status_note: A listing that owns a page, the Tony Medina shape. Three flagships already fill the home grid.
_style_note: Daniel's own phrase for him (2026-09-20). It renders as the eyebrow over his name and says the one thing that separates him from the covers acts at the same size.
_material_note: His own songs lead every set he publishes. Covers are real and on his channel (Willie Nelson, The Beatles, The Cars, a Crosby Stills and Nash song club entry), so the set can lean either way on request.
_bucket_note: cocktail and patio for the solo and the trio; specialty because a songwriter's set for a listening crowd (a house concert, a retreat evening) is a set piece guests watch; budget on the same reasoning as Tony Medina, solo voice and guitar being the smallest live booking on the roster. Not party: his set is his own songs and nothing on his site sells a dance floor.
_config_note: His EPK sells two shapes, Solo Performances and Full Band / Trio Performances, and Daniel added the duo 2026-09-20 ('there is a duo version'). The trio in his footage is voice and guitar with lead guitar and bass (the Molecule Effect clips name Joe Mazza and Steve Combs); the full band on the Roxy and UMS footage adds drums, a four piece. The duo's build is written as voice and guitar with lead guitar, the trio minus its bass, because that is the only reading of his own ladder that needs no new instrument; his site publishes no duo, so if the second musician is the bassist it is one word in the rung.
_genre_note: His EPK: Folk, Americana, Indie-folk, Folk-Rock, Singer-songwriter. The americana label was widened to 'Americana, folk and bluegrass' the day he joined so the filter says folk somewhere; no new genre id was minted.
_img_note: His own press photograph from the EPK gallery on his site (photographer Kenzie Veritt in the filename): on stage at the microphone with an acoustic guitar under warm light, cropped 16:9 with the focus a quarter of the way down so the hat, the face and the guitar body are all in frame. No duotone. Provenance in media-sources.json.

Picked for the hero over the 2026 Tiny Desk cut of the same performance (a duplicate with titles), over the full-band clips because he is sold first as a songwriter and the band has its own footage section, and over the 2019 studio takes because it is this year's. Every embed on the page was checked playableInEmbed on 2026-09-20. Daniel's rulings the same day: the Willie Nelson cover (Uvp9zMRJrhI) and all nine Underground Music Showcase 2026 clips publish; there is no memorial rule and no sponsorship or alcohol rule on this site, and the first pass was wrong to hold anything back under either. Left off as curation, never as a rule: the other Tiny Desk entries (older home recordings of songs the page already plays), the 90-second why-I-write-songs story (not a performance), and the 2024 clip under the earlier band name (naming two bands would confuse a buyer).
blurb: René Moffatt writes his own songs and sings them with an acoustic guitar. It's folk and Americana that sits on a playlist beside Josh Ritter and The Avett Brothers. He plays solo for welcome drinks, a patio or a dinner where people listen, and brings his band, René Moffatt & The Moonshadows, when the night wants one. He'll play covers alongside his own songs if you ask for them.

meta_description: Original folk and Americana songs for private events in Denver and the Colorado mountains. Solo voice and acoustic guitar, a trio, or his four piece band. Send a date and we price the night.
identity: René Moffatt writes the songs he sings. He's a folk and Americana songwriter based just outside Denver, with six records behind him, King of the Mountain and Here and Now Is Home among them, and an NPR Tiny Desk Contest entry every year since 2019. He calls it heady folk for the open-hearted, and the company he keeps on a playlist is Josh Ritter, Jeff Tweedy and The Avett Brothers.

Solo, it's a voice and an acoustic guitar. It plays under welcome drinks and on a patio at a volume people talk across, and it's the right size for a dinner party or a retreat evening where the songs are the point of the night. He's played the listening venues around Denver, Swallow Hill and the Black Rose Acoustic Society among them, and stages at the Denver Botanic Gardens and the Clyfford Still Museum.

With the band, René Moffatt & The Moonshadows, the same songs get lead guitar, bass and drums under them. The duo is his voice and guitar with a lead guitar beside it, the trio adds bass, and the four piece adds drums, which is the band you can watch on a Denver club stage and at the Underground Music Showcase in the footage below. They played the Boulder Roots Music Fest as well, and that size is the one for a park stage or a summer party.

His own songs lead a set. He plays covers beside them when a night wants them, and the ones on his channel run from Willie Nelson to The Beatles and The Cars, so tell us the balance you want and he builds the set to it.
This is a named act, booked under the name of the person who fronts it, and if anyone in the lineup changes, we tell you in advance.
